statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
